Beyond ordinary, a hidden gem
a luxury estate, nestled in 21 acres of lush green Meath countryside
Originally home to The Butlers of Dunboyne, the original Castle on the Dunboyne Estate was destroyed during the Cromwellian invasion of Ireland.  The ceiling over the staircase depicts the four elements to life at this time; War, Music, Education & Love.
It’s located just 18km from Dublin city centre, and 20km from Dublin airport. It sits at the heart of Ireland’s heritage capital and makes an incomparable base from which to explore nearby historic sites.

Originally home to The Butlers of Dunboyne, the original Castle on the Dunboyne Estate was destroyed during the Cromwellian invasion of Ireland as a result of the family s refusal to convert to Protestantism. The Georgian house that we see today was completed in 1764 by Drogheda architect George Darley. Some of the finest works from the Lafranchini Brother s ornamental stucco plasterwork is on display. The ceiling over the staircase depicts the four elements to life currently ; War, Music, Education & Love.
The last of the Butlers to reside in the Castle was the 22nd Baron of Dunboyne John Butler, Catholic Bishop of Cork. Since then, the Castle has passed through many families the Butler-O’Briens, Sadlier, Morrough -Ryans and the Watchmans. In 1955, it became home to the Good Shepherd Sisters who remained here until 1991 when it was bought by the Keating family, before the Ross family bought it in 1999.
It  was in need of much repair and Seamus Ross and his Family lovingly restored the property to its original state and opened as Dunboyne Castle Hotel & Spa in 2006.  Dunboyne Castle Hotel was acquired by Mr. Thomas Röggla in December 2022. The hotel joined his collection of luxury Irish hotels forming the TMR Hotel Collection, including Farnham Estate Spa & Golf Resort, Harvey’s Point, Mount Wolseley, Aghadoe Heights and the Ballymascanlon Hotel & Golf Resort.
THE SPA AT DUNBOYNE CASTLE
Your visit to The Spa at Dunboyne Castle promises to be so much more than just a moment in time. Instead, we focus on curating beautiful and effective well-being journeys to suit the needs of every guest. Our range of treatments, rituals and spa packages offer a unique combination of natural, sustainable, supportive, organic and vegan options whilst also delivering the specialist results-driven facials and body treatments so sought by spa guests the world over.
We offer a gender-neutral environment with the same privacy level to all guests, with treatments to suit everyone. Each one of our treatment descriptions has advice to who they are suitable for, so you check this when choosing the ideal treatment for your requirement.
A range of rejuvenating treatments are available, as well as overnight stay packages .
DINING IN DUNBOYNE CASTLE HOTEL SPA
The Ivy is about showcasing the best of modern cuisine through innovation and creativity. Our menus only feature ingredients from the fines local suppliers and are strongly influenced by our culinary team’s shared passion for using first class produce
The comfortable and cosy Terrace Lounge sits just off the Hotel Lobby. It offers a range of casual dining options from morning coffee, to bar bites over lunch , afternoon tea or nibbles and cocktails in the evening. The Terrace Lounge features al fresco dining with a large terrace overlooking the hotel gardens.
Please note the following opening days for our outlets:
Our Terrace Lounge dining menus are available from 12 noon until 21:30.
Afternoon Tea is available from 12 noon until 15:00 (pre-booking essential).
The Ivy Restaurant is opened daily for Dinner Service from 18:30.

What is your policy if I need to cancel my reservation with you last minute?
For individual bookings, our cancellation policy is 24 hours in advance of your stay. In the instance that you have booked an Advanced Purchase, we will deal with each reservation on a case-by-case basis. We would encourage you to contact us as soon as you wish to make a change to your current reservation by either emailing us on [email protected] or calling us at the hotel on +353 1 8013500
Where is Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa?
Located in the village of Dunboyne Co. Meath.
Ideally located on Dublin s Doorstep, just off the N3 and M50 road networks. Dunboyne Castle Hotel & Spa is located just 18km from Dublin city centre, and 20km from Dublin airport
What time is Check-Out?
Check-out is 12:00pm.
What time is Check-In?
Check-in is from 4:00pm. Earlier check-in is subject to availability. If you cannot check-in earlier than 4:00pm, you may leave your luggage with our Front Office team.
Can I arrange for amenities or gifts to be placed in the room?
Subject to request. Please contact [email protected] prior to arrival.
Do you have family rooms?
O ur Executive Suites can accommodate 3 adults or a family of 4 . Camp-beds & Cots are available on request and are subject to availability.
If I book online, how do I know my room is booked?
After booking, you will be sent a confirmation email to the email address you provided when making your reservation.
Is there anything to do with kids when staying there?
Yes , check out things to do both onsite and in close by attractions . Some of which include Emerald Park, Hill of Tara and Dublin Zoo.
Do you have wheelchair-accessible rooms?
Yes, please make staff aware when booking and at check-in.
Does the hotel provide adaptors?
Yes, subject to availability and a deposit is required .
What age do I have to be to check into Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa?
If you wish to check-in to our hotel, you must be at least 18 years old. If you are under 18 years old, you must be accompanied by an adult or guardian.
Is it possible to get a Late Checkout?
Late check-out is subject to availability. We offer a Duvet Day Check out at 14:00, additional charge of €30 applies.
Is there coffee making facilities in the bedrooms?
Yes.
Do you provide irons and ironing boards in the bedrooms?
Yes.
Is the hotel air-conditioned?
Yes.
Is Vat included in the room price?
Yes.
Do you have connecting rooms?
Yes, these must be requested at reservation stage.
Do you have 24-hour Room Service?
Yes.
Do I need to pre-book Parking?
No.
What other facilities are available at Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa?
Enjoy an evening meal at the award-winning IVY Restaurant , relax & enjoy afternoon tea or an after-drink cocktail in our Terrace Lounge . Embrace live entertainment in the Sadlier Bar.  Retreat to The Spa   for some relaxing treatments.
How many bedrooms does Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa have?
145 spacious rooms, modern comforts blends with traditional luxury. These include 2 exceptional Junior Suites, and an impressive Presidential Suite on the top floor of the hotel.
For more information, click the link below:
Rooms
Does Dunboyne Castle have a Spa?
The Spa at Dunboyne Castle Hotel was carefully designed to be an oasis of calm, it provides our guests a further retreat into relaxation. Treatments can be booked as part of your stay with us, or as an indulgent day out.
Guests can avail of specialist treatments, a hydrotherapy pool, heated pool loungers, sauna, steam room and fully equipped gym
For more information on facilities, treatments, packages and special offers, click the link below:
The Spa at Dunboyne Castle Hotel
What transport systems does Dunboyne have?
Dunboyne has a train station, that connects to Connolly Station in Dublin city centre, Taxi service, large car park and direct bus routes.
Dunboyne Train Station.
Dublin Bus: Dunboyne Dublin.
Does Dunboyne Castle Hotel hold weddings?
With a choice between the Georgian Drawing Room and contemporary Tara Ballroom, weddings with up to 220 guests can be held in the hotel. We operate one wedding a day policy and would be delighted to help you celebrate your special day. Discover what is on offer in our Meath wedding venue and imagine how your special day looks like to you.
For more information click the link below:
Dunboyne Castle Hotel & Spa Weddings
Is Dunboyne Castle Hotel pet-friendly?
Dunboyne Castle Hotel does not cater for pets but accepts Guide and Assistance Dogs.
Does Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa have a Restaurant?
Dunboyne Castle is home to the award-winning IVY Restaurant.  Our restaurant aims to showcase the best of modern cuisine through constant innovation and creativity.
Menus
Does Dunboyne Castle Hotel Spa Have a bar?
The elegant and contemporary Terrace Lounge sits just off the hotel lobby.  It offers a range of casual dining options.  It also features al fresco dining overlooking the gardens.
The Sadlier Bar is a traditional bar where you can enjoy all the traditional favourites: draught beers, liquors, and Irish Whiskeys, along with weekend live entertainment and sporting fixtures.
Is Parking available on-site?
Dunboyne offers a large private car park for residential guests and customers.
What time is Breakfast?
Ivy Restaurant Breakfast times: Monday to Friday 06.30am until 10.30am Saturday, Sunday & Bank Holiday Mondays 07.00am until 10.45am
Does Dunboyne Castle have Wifi?
Dunboyne offers complimentary WIFI for all guests.  Each guest room has its own secure individual WIFI.
Do you have smoking and non-smoking floors?
Dunboyne Castle Hotel & Spa is a non-smoking hotel.
Do you provide cots?
Cots are available upon request at no extra charge, subject to availability.
Do your guestrooms have a table and desk suitable for meetings with clients?
